metadata.title: Khao Lam | Sticky Rice Cooked Inside Bamboo
metadata.description:
Click to tweet and share this recipe: http://ctt.ec/25f99

Khao Lam is rice dish that's prepared by cooking sticky rice stuffed inside the bamboo. Though this method of cooking  is followed by lots of tribes residing the Northeast of India.  Khao Lam is unique to the Khampti tribe in India. They are also known as 'Tai Khamti' and reside in Namsai and Changlang district of Arunachal Pradesh.

There are many variations to this dish, Khao Lam is also prepared as a sweet dish by adding sugar, coconut milk and sweet red bean.

This dish however is plain version of it and is made  with just sticky rice and water.
